title: papaver radicatum subsp. macrostigma
intro: Papaver radicatum subsp. macrostigma, commonly known as Arctic Poppy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Papaveraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Papaver radicatum subsp. macrostigma are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
